purpose: Local-first Scripture study workspace for HeritageFaith.
privacy: Local-first. Participant names and group notes stay in app-private SQLite unless the user explicitly shares/prints/backs them up.
copyright_boundary: Only rights-cleared/public-domain Scripture is configured for bundled/installable public use. Customer imports remain customer-supplied local material.
cantus: Create/update/archive/import actions are Cantus logged by the existing records/files layers.
principle: Scripture source text remains unchanged; every added layer is separately labeled and reversible.
